- Transition 16: (17, 46) - G dot! Yes!
- Transition 18: (57, 6) - G dot! Yes!

In transition 18, I clicked (57, 6), a G dot. The purple block moved from (52-54, 9-11) to (56-58, 5-7).
Hmm, so clicking on (57, 6) moved the purple block, but clicking on other G dots didn't. What's special about (57, 6)?
(57, 6) is the LAST G dot on the trail. It's the endpoint. Maybe clicking on the endpoint moves the purple block to that position?
Or maybe the purple block moves when I click on a G dot that is "adjacent" to the current purple block position?
The purple block was at (52-54, 9-11), centered at (53, 10). The nearest G dots are (51, 12) and (55, 8). (57, 6) is not adjacent to (53, 10).
Wait, let me reconsider. Maybe the purple block moves when I click on ANY position, but the movement is subtle and I didn't notice? Let me check more carefully.
Actually, looking at the data again, the purple block stayed at (52-54, 9-11) for transitions 1-17, and only moved in transition 18. So clicking on (57, 6) specifically caused the move.
What's special about (57, 6)? It's the last G dot on the trail. Maybe the game is about moving the purple block to the end of the trail?
But the purple block is now at (56-58, 5-7), which is centered at (57, 6). So the purple block is now at the end of the trail.
Is the level complete now? No, the result says "level_completed: false".
So what's next? Maybe I need to move the purple block somewhere else?
